title: Completed root scalar compatibility in the integral tensor
statement:
Let $l$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_l$ finite, and $g:X\to Y$ an isomorphism of arbitrary schemes. Use the concrete completed Z_l ring R, root limit L, constant integral ring B and completed integral ring T [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings]. Let r be the prescribed inverse-limit root comparison [lem-pur-roots-of-unity-inverse-image-iso], and let c_T be the canonical completed integral coefficient comparison [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For every local $a\in R_Y$, $b\in B_Y$ and $x\in L_Y$, the integral tensor of $c_B(b)$ with $r(\eta(ax))$ equals the completed action of $c_T(c_Y(a))$ on the tensor of $c_B(b)$ with $r(\eta(x))$, where $c_Y:R_Y\to T_Y$ is the prescribed completed scalar inclusion. The following Lean formula specifies all objects and actions.

theorem frobeniusIntegralRootScalar
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (r : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
      (purTwistZlOne Y l) ⟶ purTwistZlOne X l)
    (hr : r = limit.post (proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower Y l Fact.out)
        (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ≫
      lim.map (((proEtaleRootsOfUnityInverseImageIso g).2.1 l Fact.out).choose)) :
    ∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (a : (purTwistZlCompletion Y l).obj.obj (op V))
      (b : (purTwistIntegralConstant Y l E).obj.obj (op V))
      (x : (purTwistZlOne Y l).obj.obj (op V)),
      purTwistIntegralTensor X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
        ((proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap g CommRingCat.{u + 1}
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).hom.app
              (op V) b)
        (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
              (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
                (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V)
                  (@SMul.smul _ _ (purTwistZlAction Y l (op V)).toSMul a x))) =
      @SMul.smul _ _
        (purTwistIntegralAction X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))).toSMul
        ((sfCompletedCoefficientMap l E g).hom.app (op V)
          ((purTwistCompletedScalarMap Y l E).hom.app (op V) a))
        (purTwistIntegralTensor X l E (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          ((proEtaleConstantDirectImageMap g CommRingCat.{u + 1}
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))).hom.app
              (op V) b)
          (r.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
              (((proEtaleSheafAdjunction g AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).unit.app
                (purTwistZlOne Y l)).hom.app (op V) x)))

proof.text: The compatible finite constant Z/l^(n+1) direct-image comparisons define a cone from R_Y to the direct-image coefficient tower. Its limit lift, followed by the inverse right-adjoint limit comparison, constructs rho:R_Y to g_*R_X. limit.lift_pi and limit.post_pi give its finite projection formula. Transition compatibility is constant_naturality applied to the quotient maps.

Test root_direct(a*x)=rho(a)*root_direct(x) at every root projection. The coordinate action formula, root_direct_project_value and root_direct_linear reduce it to the projection equation for rho. root_section_ext proves equality of the root-limit sections.

Prove c_Y followed by c_T equals rho followed by g_*c_X. For a target coefficient projection choose its finite p-adic factor q from the specification of c_Y. The same q factors c_X: compare with its chosen factor by surjectivity of finite p-adic reduction and purTwistZlFiniteFactor_ext. The desired square then reduces to constant_naturality for q and the projection equation for rho. Adjunction and limit extensionality give equality of the maps.

Use the root scalar equation just proved and the coefficient square. The normalization clause of purTwistIntegralAction moves a completed Z_l scalar from the root factor to the completed integral action. Rewriting root_direct as the adjunct of the prescribed r yields the exact displayed formula.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean proof using the existing constructions. Private root/tensor sublemmas reused from AmbRootTowerPullbackCoherence quantify over arbitrary schemes; the public coherence package with its invertibility hypothesis is not applied.

mathlib_searches.query: The inverse limit of compatible semilinear maps is semilinear, and scalar extension preserves this action on pure tensors.
